trial.jaymospowers.kill_power: Fell %s hostile creatures with your power
trial.jaymospowers.deep: Go down into the deep dark (below Y -40)
trial.jaymospowers.high: Stand up among the clouds (above Y 200)
trial.jaymospowers.thought.done: %s. Further than I thought I could go.
trial.jaymospowers.thought.swap_back: A job done clears my head: I could think of something else to push at.
screen.jaymospowers.trials.all: You have pushed past every limit you could think of.
screen.jaymospowers.trials.waiting: Nothing comes to mind yet: learn more of your power.
screen.jaymospowers.trials.how: Your own thoughts on how to push your limits. Each done is mastery; finishing any quest gives a swap back.
message.jaymospowers.brink: At the edge, something in you wakes a little. It is closer now.
message.jaymospowers.trade.no_power: You have no power to trade.
message.jaymospowers.trade.face: Face the one you would trade powers with.
message.jaymospowers.trade.offered: You hold your earring out to %s: trade powers? Both of you must say yes twice.
message.jaymospowers.trade.asked: %s would trade powers with you: sneak and use your earring facing them.
message.jaymospowers.trade.again: Both of you are willing. Sneak and use the earring once more to be sure.
message.jaymospowers.trade.waiting: %s is sure. Sneak and use your earring once more to trade.
message.jaymospowers.trade.failed: The earrings hold nothing to trade: both of you need one in hand, and a different power.
message.jaymospowers.trade.done: The earrings crack. %s is yours now, and it starts again from its first ability.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.lift.thought: Weight is only a habit. I could lift a few more of them and see.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.hurl.thought: Holding them is easy. I wonder how far I could throw one.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.weightless.th: I could let go of the ground for a while. A long while.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.push: Push %s held creatures through the air
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.push.thought: One shove while I hold it. I could send it a long way.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.planet: Fall to %s planets you have thrown
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.planet.though: A knot of weight, thrown ahead of me, and its down is mine. I could travel that way.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.well_many: Hold %s creatures in one Gravity Well
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.well_many.tho: One well, three of them on their knees. I could hold that many.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.board.thought: A slab of the ground under my feet, and the sky ahead. I could ride it longer.
No blade, no fire. Their own weight could do it for me.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.crush.thought: I could press down harder. Enough to flatten a crowd.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.wave.thought: A wall of weight, thrown ahead of me. I could catch more of them in it.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.inversion: Turn the weight inside %s held creatures
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.inversion.tho: What I hold has weight inside it too. I could turn that over.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.rocks: Strike %s times with your harnessed rocks
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.rocks.thought: The stones follow me already. I could teach them to hit.
trial.jaymospowers.gravity.overturn.thou: Their down could be my up. I could turn one right over.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.rewind.thought: A minute of my life, lived twice. I could take that much back.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.water.thought: Fast enough, and water is only a road. I could stay on it longer.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.flurry.thought: My hands are faster than their eyes. I could land more before they blink.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.phase.thought: A wall is only slow. I could shake myself through it.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.bloom_heal: Mend wounds in your Time Bloom %s times
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.bloom_heal.tho: Wounds close with time. I have time to give.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.gear.thought: There is another gear above this one. I could find it.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.slow_time: Slow the world to a crawl %s times
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.slow_time.thou: The world could wait for me. I only have to run fast enough.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.stasis_many: Hold %s creatures in one Stasis Field
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.stasis_many.th: Four of them, stopped between one tick and the next. I could hold that.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.ring.thought: Round and round, fast enough, and the air comes with me.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.decoys.thought: I could be in more places than they can count.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.wind_day.thoug: The sun moves when I lean on the hour. I could turn a whole day past.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.wall_run.thoug: Up is only another way to run.
trial.jaymospowers.chrono.cheat_death.th: Even that could be taken back. Once, to know that I can.
trial.jaymospowers.web.swing_far: Swing %s blocks without touching the ground
trial.jaymospowers.web.swing_far.thought: The ground is a habit too. I could go a hundred blocks without it.
trial.jaymospowers.web.trick.thought: A flip off the line costs nothing. I could make it look easy.
trial.jaymospowers.web.whip: Slam %s creatures with the Web Whip
trial.jaymospowers.web.whip.thought: Both webs on one of them. I could swing it like a flail.
trial.jaymospowers.web.wallrun.thought: A wall is a floor on its side. I could run it.
trial.jaymospowers.web.yank.thought: One line, one pull. I could have them off their feet before they know.
trial.jaymospowers.web.hitch: Hitch %s creatures to a wall or ceiling
trial.jaymospowers.web.hitch.thought: I could leave one tied up where it stands, like a lead on a fence.
trial.jaymospowers.web.hang.thought: The world looks different from under a ledge. I could stay a while.
trial.jaymospowers.web.shot.thought: I could web them up from across the street.
trial.jaymospowers.web.bridge.thought: A line from here to there, tight enough to walk. I could build my own roads.
trial.jaymospowers.web.parkour: Vault, slide and wall jump %s times
trial.jaymospowers.web.parkour.thought: Over it, under it, off the wall. I could cross this place without slowing.
trial.jaymospowers.web.string_up: Haul %s creatures up to hang beside you
trial.jaymospowers.web.string_up.thought: From up here I could pull one up and leave it hanging.
trial.jaymospowers.web.swing_marathon: Swing %s blocks without touching the ground
trial.jaymospowers.web.swing_marathon.th: Five hundred blocks and never a foot down. I could cross a city like that.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.flight.thought: The wind will carry me if I let it. I could stay up longer than this.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.ram.thought: I am fast enough to hit like a storm front. I could fly straight through one.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.barrier_push: Throw back %s creatures with the Gale Barrier
trial.jaymospowers.wind.barrier_push.tho: A wall of wind round me. I could make them keep their distance.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.douse.thought: Fire is only air that forgot itself. I could blow it out like a candle.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.zephyr.thought: There is a gentle wind in me too. I could breathe it over the ones who need it.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.deflect: Turn aside %s shots with the Gale Barrier
trial.jaymospowers.wind.deflect.thought: An arrow is light. The wind could send it back where it came from.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.whistle: Blow creatures back with the Wind Whistle for %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.wind.whistle.thought: One long breath, and nothing could walk into it.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.gust.thought: I could gather more of the wind before I let it go.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.tailwind: Launch yourself on a Tailwind %s times
trial.jaymospowers.wind.tailwind.thought: The wind at my back, all at once. I could ride it.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.cyclone: Hold creatures in your Cyclone for %s seconds in all
trial.jaymospowers.wind.cyclone.thought: I could turn until the wind turns with me, and take them up into it.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.dive.thought: From high enough, I am the storm coming down.
trial.jaymospowers.wind.sonic: Fly at sonic speed for %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.wind.sonic.thought: There is a speed where the air breaks. I could find it and hold it.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.slide: Skate your Ice Slide for %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.slide.thought: The ice goes where I go. I could skate further than I have yet.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.slide_water: Skate across open water for %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.slide_water.thou: Water is only ice that has not met me. I could cross it standing up.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.breath: Hold creatures in your Frost Breath for %s seconds in all
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.breath.thought: One long cold breath. I could keep it on them until they stop.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.freeze_water: Freeze over %s blocks of water with Frost Breath
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.freeze_water.tho: I could breathe across a pond and walk home over it.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.wall.thought: A wall where there was none. I could build faster than they can come.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.shards.thought: A handful of ice, thrown hard. I could make every one count.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.shards_far: Hit a creature with an Ice Shard from %s blocks away
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.shards_far.thoug: A shard flies straight. I could hit one from much further off.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.flash_freeze.tho: One look, and it stands in ice. I could do that to more of them.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.shatter: Strike %s frozen creatures with Ice Shards
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.shatter.thought: Frozen, it cannot move. I could put a shard through the ice.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.freeze_big: Flash Freeze a creature with %s health or more
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.freeze_big.thoug: The big ones freeze as well as the small. I should try one.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.wall_nether: Raise an Ice Wall in the Nether
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.wall_nether.thou: Ice, in that place. I want to see it stand there.
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.blizzard_hold: Hold creatures in your Blizzard for %s seconds in all
trial.jaymospowers.cryo.blizzard_hold.th: When all of it is mine, I could bring the whole winter down on them.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.vapour.thought: I could come apart and drift. Longer, this time.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.soft_landing: Come down from a fall as smoke %s times
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.soft_landing.th: Smoke does not break when it lands. Neither would I.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.screen: Pour out a Smokescreen for %s seconds in all
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.screen.thought: There is more smoke in me than this. I could fill a whole street.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.pass: Let %s blows pass through you as smoke
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.pass.thought: A blade cannot cut smoke. I could stand there and let them try.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.jet: Hit creatures with the Smoke Jet %s times
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.jet.thought: Pushed hard enough, smoke hits like a fist.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.bomb.thought: One throw, and none of them can see. I could get good at that.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.step: Smoke Step into your own clouds %s times
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.step.thought: Any cloud of mine is a door. I could step through.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.smother: Smother creatures for %s seconds in all
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.smother.thought: Smoke goes where breath goes. I could hold it there.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.bomb_many: Catch %s creatures in one Smoke Bomb
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.bomb_many.thoug: One bomb in the middle of them. I could take all their eyes at once.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.sight: Spend %s seconds with Smoke Sight on
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.sight.thought: In my smoke I see everything. I should learn to look.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.choke: Choke the air out of creatures %s times
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.choke.thought: If I hold on long enough, there is no air left in them.
trial.jaymospowers.smoke.whole.thought: Nothing on me, nothing of me. All smoke. I could let go that far.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.echo.though: If I listen, the walls stop mattering. I could hear what moves behind them.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.lure: Lure %s creatures with a thrown voice
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.lure.though: A sound where I am not. They would walk right to it.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.pulse.thoug: My voice could hit harder than my hands.
One shout, and all of them in front of it. I could catch three.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.shatter_blo: Everything has a note it breaks on. I could find more of them.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.echo_deep.t: Down there, sound is the only light. I should learn to see by it.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.strip: Shake the armour on creatures %s times
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.strip.thoug: Armour rings like a bell. I could make it ring until it cracks.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.hush_many.t: A dome with no sound in it, and four of them inside. I could hold that silence.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.shatter_hit: Finish a hum on a creature %s times
Hold the note on one of them, then let it go all at once.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.echo_many: Hear %s creatures at once with Echolocation
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.echo_many.t: If I listen properly, I could count every heartbeat round me.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.quiet: Stay Quiet for %s seconds in all
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.quiet.thoug: No step, no breath, nothing. I could be that quiet for longer.
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.pulse_far: Strike a creature with a Pulse from %s blocks away
trial.jaymospowers.resonance.pulse_far.t: A voice carries. Mine could carry further and still hurt.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.strike.thoug: A blade of dark water, raised and brought down. I could make it land every time.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.parry.though: Still water turns a blade aside. I could wait for the blow and meet it.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.undertow.tho: The water under them is mine. I could pull them down into it.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.shadow: Take %s shadows from what you fell
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.shadow.thoug: What I fell leaves a shadow behind. I could keep it.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.crescent.tho: One wide cut, like a wave breaking. I could catch more of them in it.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.riposte.thou: Turn the blade, then cut back before they know. I could be that quick.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.surf: Surf the dark water for %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.surf.thought: A wave under my feet, going where I look. I could ride it further.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.tide: Sweep %s creatures away with the Black Tide
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.tide.thought: I could call the whole tide in and let it carry them off.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.cripple: Cut the legs from under %s foes
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.cripple.thou: A cut to the legs, and they crawl. I could aim lower.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.geyser: Throw %s foes up on a Geyser
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.geyser.thoug: The water could come up under them like a fist.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.pit: Swallow %s foes in a Devouring Pit
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.pit.thought: The dark has a mouth. I could open it under them.
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.reflect: Send back %s shots with your guard
trial.jaymospowers.darktide.reflect.thou: An arrow is slower than the tide. I could turn it round.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.reach: Pull %s weapons out of the rift
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.reach.thought: There is always another blade in there. I could reach in again.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.ride: Ride a great blade for %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.ride.thought: A blade big enough to stand on. I could ride it like a board.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.return: Send %s weapons back into the rift
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.return.though: What I borrow, I could give back before it fades.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.rift: Open %s rifts to your Pocket Dimension
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.rift.thought: There is a room behind the air that is only mine. I could open the door.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.portal.though: Two doors and nothing between them. I could walk through.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.barrage.thoug: A sky full of blades, all pointing one way. I could make them land.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.storm: Cut creatures %s times with a Blade Storm
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.storm.thought: Not one volley. A storm of them, for as long as I can hold it open.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.chains.though: Chains out of the rift, round one of them. I could hold it fast.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.cannons: Hit creatures %s times with the Cannon Battery
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.cannons.thoug: The rift holds more than blades. I could roll out the guns.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.wing: Cut creatures %s times with your Attendant Blades
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.wing.thought: Blades that follow me and strike on their own. I could keep a wing of them.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.chain_yank.th: It is on my chain. I could pull it in.
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.barrage_far: Strike a creature with a Barrage blade from %s blocks away
trial.jaymospowers.arsenal.barrage_far.t: A blade from the rift flies as far as I can see. I could hit one from there.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.blink.thought: Here, then there. I could cover more ground without crossing it.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.air.thought: I do not need the ground to step from. I could blink out of a fall.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.strike.though: Behind it before it turns. I could do that again and again.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.untouched.tho: In the instant between, nothing can touch me. I could time it to their swing.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.strike_far: Blink Strike a foe from %s blocks away
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.strike_far.th: I only have to see it. I could reach one from much further off.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.vanish.though: A burst of smoke and I am gone. I could leave more of them groping.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.vanish_many: Lose %s hunters at once with Vanish
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.vanish_many.t: Three of them after me, and then none of them know where I am.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.drop.thought: Up with it, and let go. I could come back down before it does.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.strike_air: Blink Strike %s foes that are off the ground
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.strike_air.th: It is still falling. I could be there before it lands.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.blink_long.th: My step is longer than this. I could find the whole length of it.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.drop_big: Sky Drop a foe with %s health or more
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.drop_big.thou: The big ones fall just as far. I could take one up.
trial.jaymospowers.blinker.end_blink.tho: This step came from there. I want to take it on its own ground.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.cone.thought: The heart wants out. I could punch it out through my hands.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.land: Land from a fall of %s blocks
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.land.thought: Every landing feeds the heart. A higher one would feed it more.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.dash: Catch %s creatures in a Blast Dash
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.dash.thought: I could go off like a shell and take them with me.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.overload.thou: Full, it has to go somewhere. I could let it.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.beam: Catch %s creatures in Shell Beam bursts
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.beam.thought: A shell of light, down the line of my eye. I could put it where they stand.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.recoil: Catch %s creatures in a Recoil blast
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.recoil.though: Blast what is in front and ride it backwards. I could use that.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.crack: Hit %s creatures with a Ground Crack
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.crack.thought: The ground could split ahead of me, as far as the charge goes.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.drill.thought: The heart could chew through stone. I could dig a road with it.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.toss: Catch %s creatures with a Charged Throw
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.toss.thought: Anything I hold could carry the charge. I only have to throw it.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.beam_far: Burst a Shell Beam %s blocks away
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.beam_far.thou: It flies further than I have ever sent it. I could find out how far.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.overload_many: If it must go off, let it go off in the middle of them.
trial.jaymospowers.reactor.full.thought: All of it at once, the dial wide open. I could spend the whole heart in one move.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.enact.thought: What I write is true for a while. I could write it more often.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.book.thought: One rule is a sentence. Five would be a law.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.foes.thought: A rule does not have to be about me. It could be about them.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.target: Enact %s rules about the one you look at
trial.jaymospowers.rules.target.thought: One rule, for that one there and nobody else.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.pick: Enact %s rules other than your book's first
trial.jaymospowers.rules.pick.thought: The first page is a habit. I could turn to the others.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.allies.thought: A rule could hold the ones beside me up as well.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.many: Hold %s under one rule at once
trial.jaymospowers.rules.many.thought: The same sentence, true of five at the same time.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.repeal.thought: What I wrote, I could strike out, and keep the ink.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.long: Enact a rule that lasts %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.rules.long.thought: A rule that stays true for a whole minute. I could afford to write that.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.strength.though: The same words, pressed harder into the page.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.mute: Rule %s times that someone has no powers
trial.jaymospowers.rules.mute.thought: The dearest sentence I know: they have no powers. I could write it.
trial.jaymospowers.rules.at_once.thought: One law at a time is a beginner's hand. I could hold three.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_r: Use an alien's first move %s times
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_r.thoug: Every body the band gives me has a first trick. I could learn it by heart.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.slam.thought: The band is on my wrist for a reason. I could slam it more often.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.time.thought: I turn back too soon. I could stay in the other skin for a while.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_g: Use an alien's second move %s times
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_g.thoug: There is a second trick in every one of them. I keep forgetting it.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.blows.though: These hands are not mine and they hit harder. I could use them.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.soak: Take %s harm in an alien's body
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.soak.thought: The alien's skin is a second life. I could let it take the beating.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_v: Use an alien's third move %s times
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_v.thoug: The third trick is the odd one. I could find out what it is for.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.forms.though: One alien is a costume. Four would be a choice.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.scan.thought: The band wants to read things. I could point it at something new.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_b: Use an alien's fourth move %s times
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.move_b.thoug: The last trick is the big one. I could stop saving it.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.dry: Stay changed until the band runs dry %s times
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.dry.thought: I always turn back early. I could ride it down to the last beep.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.skill.though: The band has learned things about me. I could teach it something back.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.quick.though: One alien into another with no stop between. I could learn that turn of the dial.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.wild: Let the wild dial change you %s times
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.wild.thought: I could let the band choose for once and see who I get.
trial.jaymospowers.xenoform.reforged.tho: The band hums toward a forge on a far world. I could take it there.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.charge.thoug: The ki comes when I stand my ground and call it. I could call it longer.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.punch.though: My fists are the first thing I have. I could wear them in.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.eat.thought: This body burns everything I give it. I could feed it properly.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.blast_hit.th: A blast that misses is only a light. I could learn to aim it.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.full: Charge your ki to the brim %s times
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.full.thought: I always stop short of full. I could find out what full feels like.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.parry.though: Arms up a breath before the blow lands. I could catch that moment.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.step_at.thou: Gone from the front and there at the back. I could make them lose me.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.finisher.tho: Four blows set it up and the fifth sends it flying. I could finish what I start.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.flight: Fly on your ki for %s seconds
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.flight.thoug: The ki can carry me if I let it. I could stay up there for a while.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.wave_hit: Hit %s creatures with a ki beam
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.wave_hit.tho: Both hands, everything I have, in one line. I could put something in front of it.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.slam: Send %s foes flying into a wall or the ground
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.slam.thought: A finisher is not done until they hit something. I could pick the wall.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.shadowbox.th: No foe, no ki, only the forms. I could train with nobody watching.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.blast_far: Hit a creature with thrown ki from %s blocks away
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.blast_far.th: A blast holds together a long way. I could pick out something far off.
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.wave_many: Catch %s creatures in one ki beam
trial.jaymospowers.zfighter.wave_many.th: One beam, and all of them in its road. I could line them up.
